notes:
Big relabelling: Screen and Widget were catch-all labels. Screen functions were moved by source file to the screen classes of other groups (objmenu/objm_*/objmenuw -> CampScreen g07; mainmenu -> MainMenu, optmenui -> OptMenu, i_sms -> Sms, gameover -> GameOver, savemenu -> SaveMenu, sprite2d -> Sprite2D g08; hud -> Hud, i_igmenu -> IngameMenu g06; minires -> Minimap g14; i_vict -> VictoryScreen, i_qsave -> QuickSaveScreen g15; sysen -> SysEn, credits -> Credits g04; popupwin -> PopUpWin g01; i_endscr -> EndScreen g14). Their fields are not all declared by those groups yet (e.g. OptMenu +0x2c..+0x44/+0xec..+0x11d: optmenui has several option pages, maybe separate classes; GameOver +0x9da..+0x9ec; VictoryScreen +0xd2e/+0xd32; MainMenu cheat buffer +0x342e).
Widget: button2d.cpp -> Button (g03, size 0x346 = new size of the Widget label), ctl2d.cpp -> Ctl (g03; Ctl has x/y words at +5/+7, not Widget-derived), image2d.cpp -> Image2d (g01), scroll2d.cpp -> Scroll (g08), dlgres -> DlgRes (g15), esstate2 script nodes -> ScriptNode / ScriptObject / ScriptCall (g16, by vtable) or Script (mine).
Mislabelled Unit methods (Building::progress/drop_2f9/on_event_54ffd0, drain_unit, take_half, take_c6, f_work time_left 0x46b600) -> Unit (g09): fields +0xa/+0x52/+0x86/+0xc6/+0x2f1/+0x2f5/+0x2f9 are Unit fields.
Workshop (g08, add_type 0x46a6f0) is the same object as Siege (f_work.cpp, size 0x2f14); FlagFacility (g15) and Building/Siege share the Facility base (+0x4 kind, +0x8 name, +0x29 pos, +0x35 angle, +0x39 bounds, +0x51/+0x55 entrances, +0x6d owner) - g15 may want base Facility.
Music game functions (update_4e6fe0 +0x3a game state, init_demo / resolve_path +0x4b/+0x4c CD path) -> Game (g11). Error/Heap are the error-handler object. Mirror::reset -> Reorder (g02); Rect::overlaps/extend -> MouseCursor (g13, caller MouseCursor::move); Dlg::trigger_63beb0 -> String (g13); descbox 0x6b8d50/0x6b8d80/0x6b9490 -> HelpBox (g11); 0x4e6fb0 -> Effect (g03); ComInit 0x6862d0 -> VideoCapture (g16).
